newsitem.title: USA: Great Western reviews latest Ahmanson bid.
newsitem.headline: Great Western reviews latest Ahmanson bid.

text.p: Great Western Financial Corp, responding to an improved offer by H.F. Ahmanson and Co, said Monday it will review the revised proposal.
The company said its board urges stockholders not to sign any consent card sent by Ahmanson.
"Great Western continues to oppose any effort by Ahmanson to limit the Great Western board's flexibility and alternatives," it said.
On March 6, Great Western signed a definitive agreement to be acquired by Washington Mutual Savings Bank in a deal worth $6.6 billion. At the time, Ahmanson's offer was valued at $6.1 billion.
Ahmanson, in its annoncement today, said its improved offer provides a premium of $400 million or about $3 a share over the implied value of Washinton Mutual's proposal.
